newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks extend losses, investors picky.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks extend losses, investors picky.

text.p: Croatian stocks extended their losses on Thursday in diversified trade, with investors focusing on a few selected issues.
* Six of 15 active stocks fell, only three rose and six closed flat.
* Volume almost doubled to 13,577 units and turnover rose to 7.8 from 4.0 million kuna.
* Most actively traded issue with 5,243 shares sold was Pliva, adding one kuna to close at 421.
* Another blue chip Zagrebacka Banka ordinaries ended flat at 1,825 kuna on volume of 1,919.
* Top gainer Varazdinska Banka first issue rose 50 percent to 42,000 kuna but only one share was traded. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
